# UNC Target, Estimator, and Rank Table

| Fact | Exact r0.2 contract |
| --- | --- |
| Availability prerequisite | ODQ-105A all-member completion and exact named-use GEN/member/ensemble admission. |
| Target law | Conditional detector-sign-randomization law for one exact fixed parent/operator/design. |
| Center | Known target-law zero from complement symmetry, only after the ODQ-105B prerequisites. |
| Estimator | `Vhat_cond(p) = sum_b omega_b M_b(p)^2`; exact nonnegative design weights summing to one. |
| Excluded estimators | No finite-ensemble mean subtraction; no `B-1`; no survivor, pairwise, zero-filled, interpolated, or domain-extended substitute. |
| Domain | Exact common map rows where every admitted member is valid and finite. |
| Unit | Squared signal unit. |
| Narrow label | Conditional detector-sign-randomization marginal variance/second moment for the fixed declared target. |
| Explicit exclusions | Not repeated physical-noise variance, total MAP uncertainty, covariance completeness, precision, or significance. |
| Counts | `N_requested`, `N_resolved`, `N_completed`, `N_admitted`, `N_unique_sign`, `N_unique_orbit`, each separately reported. |
| Ranks | `r_sign` and the named-use `r_map`, separately reported; neither is a count or estimator uncertainty. |
| Information | Named-use effective Monte Carlo information separately reported. |
| Estimator uncertainty | Numerical and explicit, or typed unavailable. |
| Covariance | Retained ensemble, fixed projection, structured covariance, full covariance, and unavailable are separate versioned roles; absent covariance is not zero or independence. |
